title: 고민 상담: 고민, 조언, 해결하다
objective: By the end, you can use words such as 고민, 상담하다, 조언, 충고, and 해결하다 in short sentences to talk about a worry and the help you got.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about worries, asking for advice, and solving problems with friends, family, or a counselor.

task.title: Use the right word
task.line: Read each sentence and choose, complete, or arrange the words that fit the situation.

words.meaning: a worry; something you keep thinking about because you don't know what to do
words.exampleMeaning: These days I have a lot on my mind about my future career.

words.meaning: to talk with someone (often a counselor or teacher) to get help with a problem
words.example: 고민이 있으면 학교 상담 센터에서 상담해 보세요.
words.exampleMeaning: If something is bothering you, try talking to someone at the school counseling center.

words.meaning: helpful advice or a suggestion about what to do
words.example: 선배의 조언 덕분에 면접을 잘 봤어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Thanks to my senior's advice, I did well in the interview.

words.meaning: advice that points out a mistake or a bad habit; a warning
words.exampleMeaning: I listened to my friend's warning and cut down on drinking.
I talked with my roommate and we sorted out the problem.

words.meaning: to feel worried or nervous about something
words.exampleMeaning: I'm worried about next week's exam.

words.meaning: to talk something over with someone before deciding
words.exampleMeaning: Talk the moving question over with your family.

words.example: 상담 선생님 말씀이 큰 도움이 됐어요.
words.exampleMeaning: What the counselor said really helped me.

words.meaning: to feel relieved (literally, 'the heart is light')
words.example: 친구에게 다 말하고 나니까 마음이 가벼워졌어요.
words.exampleMeaning: After I told my friend everything, I felt relieved.

words.meaning: to listen to someone (for their sake)
words.example: 제 이야기를 끝까지 들어 줘서 고마워요.
words.exampleMeaning: Thanks for listening to me all the way through.

exercises: Choose the right word (고민 / 상담): ① 회사 일이 너무 많아서 요즘 ____이 있어요. ② 어제 진로 문제로 교수님과 ____했어요.
Choose 조언 or 충고: ① 동생이 수업 시간에 자꾸 휴대폰을 봐서 따끔하게 ____했어요. ② 처음 이력서를 쓸 때 선배가 좋은 ____을 많이 해 줬어요.
Write the stem of 해결하다 that goes before -기 (the part before -기): ① 이 문제는 혼자 ____기 어려워요. 같이 방법을 찾아봐요. ② 친구와 이야기하면 문제를 ____기 쉬워요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence. Any natural order is fine if 의논했어요 comes last: 의논했어요 / 부모님과 / 어제 / 유학 문제를
Fill in the blank with 걱정되다 or 마음이 가볍다 in the -아요/어요 form: ① 비행기를 처음 타서 좀 ____. ② 숙제를 다 끝내서 ____.
Complete the conversation: ① A: 요즘 고민이 좀 있어. B: 그래? 내가 이야기 ____ 줄게. ② A: 네 조언이 정말 ____ 됐어. 고마워.
answers: 어제 부모님과 유학 문제를 의논했어요. (Other orders are also correct if 의논했어요 comes last, e.g. 어제 유학 문제를 부모님과 의논했어요. / 부모님과 어제 유학 문제를 의논했어요.)
